name: capability-readiness-card-states
description: Verify the launcher renders target capability facts with the four-state vocabulary, keeps missing capabilities visible and non-launchable, and shows versions for ready agents.

metadata.name: capability-readiness-card-states
metadata.description: Verify the launcher renders target capability facts with the four-state vocabulary, keeps missing capabilities visible and non-launchable, and shows versions for ready agents.

evaluate.expression: (() => { const allowed = new Set(['ready','missing','not_applicable','unknown']); const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-capability-id]')]; const valid = cards.length > 0 && cards.every((card) => allowed.has(card.getAttribute('data-capability-state') || '')); const readyVersioned = cards.filter((card) => card.getAttribute('data-capability-state') === 'ready').every((card) => Boolean(card.getAttribute('data-capability-version'))); document.body.setAttribute('data-capability-readiness-valid', valid && readyVersioned ? 'true' : 'false'); })()

assert.failure_message: Expected capability cards to carry an allowed readiness state and versions for ready agents
